experiments.name: Multi-Cohort Grand Benchmark Evaluation
experiments.falsifies_if: SurvTD fails to achieve at least 0.025 improvement in time-dependent AUC and concordance over DeepTCSR and Dynamic-DeepHit on MIMIC-IV Sepsis-3 or Poisson-downsampled C-MAPSS.

experiments.name: Comparative Baseline Ladder Parity
experiments.falsifies_if: Under matched 20-trial Bayesian HPO and shared sequence backbones, Person-period discrete hazard on 1h grid or clamped DeepTCSR matches or exceeds SurvTD within seed noise on irregularly sampled cohorts.

experiments.name: Mechanism-Isolating Factorial Ablation NC-A
experiments.falsifies_if: Ablating duration discounting (Arm A1: gamma_j = S(delta_s)) or continuous renewal shifting (Arm A2: Phi_{+delta_s}) retains more than 50% of the concordance gain over the unit-step baseline.

experiments.name: Negative Control NC-B: Within-Patient Duration Permutation
experiments.falsifies_if: Scrambling inter-visit durations Delta t_j within patient trajectories retains more than half of the performance gain over the unregularized baseline, indicating that gains stem from passive visit counting rather than continuous temporal alignment.

experiments.name: Negative Control NC-A3: Clamped Division Comparison
experiments.falsifies_if: Heuristic clamped division p / max(S, 1e-3) matches the training stability, gradient variance, and high-risk calibration of SurvTD renewal mixture without loss divergence.

experiments.name: Lambda-Return Compounding & Horizon Invariance Sweep NC-C
experiments.falsifies_if: Performance does not show an inverted-U curve with optimal lambda in [0.4, 0.8], or count-geometric lambda^k matches duration-geometric lambda^(Delta t / delta_s) across varying observation sampling frequencies.

experiments.name: Clinical Utility & ICU Bedside Alarm Fatigue Evaluation
experiments.falsifies_if: SurvTD fails to achieve at least a 25% reduction in false alert episode rate per patient-day and alert jitter count at matched 0.30 PPV compared to EMA-smoothed Dynamic-DeepHit on MIMIC-IV Sepsis-3.

experiments.name: Projection Variance Diffusion & Contraction Sensitivity
experiments.falsifies_if: Cumulative projection variance exceeds the theoretical bound of delta_s^2 / 6 per step or Cramér distance loss fails to decrease monotonically under positive hazard.

statistics.variance_reported: Mean and standard deviation across 5 evaluation seeds with paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test and 1000-sample test bootstrap 95% confidence intervals
statistics.meaningful_delta: 0.025 in time-dependent AUC and concordance (derived: 3x 5-seed bootstrap test SE of 0.008 on MIMIC-IV Sepsis-3); >= 25% reduction in alert jitter at matched 0.30 PPV

tuning_parity: All baselines (DeepTCSR with continuous Delta t feature and clamped division, Dynamic-DeepHit, Person-period discrete hazard on 1h regular grid, and SurvTD) share identical continuous-time GRU-D or LSTM sequence backbones and receive an identical 20-trial Bayesian hyperparameter optimization budget searching learning rates (1e-4 to 5e-3), latent dimensions (64 to 256), dropout (0.1 to 0.5), and EMA smoothing parameters under strict subject-level 5-fold cross-validation.

kill_criteria.abandon_if: If within-patient duration permutation EXP-04 retains more than 50% of the concordance gain, or NC-A ablation EXP-03 fails to show significant degradation from unit-step baseline, C0 is falsified and withdrawn.
If the Cramér distance loss diverges or fails to exhibit contraction modulus bounded by gamma_j under a frozen target network, C1 is falsified and withdrawn.
If pure Monte Carlo NLL (lambda = 1.0) matches optimal multi-step lambda within seed noise, or projection variance diffusion exceeds delta_s^2 / 6, C2 is falsified and withdrawn.
If SurvTD does not outperform clamped DeepTCSR and Dynamic-DeepHit by at least 0.025 in AUC/concordance on MIMIC-IV Sepsis-3 or Poisson-downsampled C-MAPSS, C3 is falsified and withdrawn.
If SurvTD fails to reduce false alert episode rates and alert jitter by at least 25% at matched 0.30 PPV against EMA-smoothed Dynamic-DeepHit, C4 is falsified and withdrawn.
